notes: SBLGNT.LUK.21.37.v038 is underdetermined with r00-base carried; every token of the base is realized in the ASV.

Both articles of the accusative of time take the supplied determiner every, no other source token competing for the slot; that is rules 51 and 60's argument for a third kind of supplied determiner, and the chapter writes both occurrences the same way under rule 24.
The first article of the mount phrase takes the English the, so the second attributive article is unrepresented under rules 23 and 31 and the participle keeps that is called.
